look_here_first: First decide whether you have a tree yucca with fleshy fruit. If yes, look for Torrey’s traditional field combination: rigid spear-like leaves with marginal threads, the leaf tip portion often rolled inward, versus the mostly non-threaded, non-inrolled leaves of Trecul’s yucca.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: arborescent/tree-like yucca with a trunk and crown of rigid dagger leaves

key_traits.label: Identification

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: apical leaf portion often inrolled so margins approach each other

key_traits.label: Identification

key_traits.label: Identification
